components.name: PySide6-Essentials
components.purpose: Native Qt Widgets desktop for the reviewed plain-text DGN workflow

artifacts.version_evidence: dependency-evidence/PySide6-Essentials-6.11.2-pypi.json; latest upload conservatively bounds version publication

approval.basis: User requests correction of the Qt 6.11.2 block. Scoped local development review, not human/legal or release-owner sign-off.

security.justification: Current desktop renders DGN content through QPlainTextEdit and exposes no font-file loading, subsetting, printing/PDF, or image preview/encoding. HarfBuzz report requires font subsetting; this flow does not provide its input/sink. The libjpeg report uses the TurboJPEG tj3Compress8 wrapper, absent from tagged Qt JPEG build sources; this app also supplies no DGN images to Qt codecs. Exact wheel inventory has no VNC module. QtXml ReturnNullNode vendor policy is set before UI use; the app does not serialize QDom input. Application-specific decision retains upstream affected versions; it does not assert native binaries are patched or vulnerability-free.
constraints: XML mitigation regression must pass before desktop validation
Re-review before font loading, printing/PDF, image preview, new Qt modules/plugins, or wheel updates
